verdict.rationale: GitLab documents a comprehensive REST/GraphQL API ('Interact programmatically with GitLab') and auth mechanisms (PATs, SSH keys) plus a CLI and MCP server, suggesting broad programmatic access, but there is no evidence explicitly confirming full UI-API parity or documenting gaps/exceptions. missing for 10: explicit parity statement or audit showing all UI actions are API-exposed, independent verification of completeness, and any mention of known UI-only features.
